source.buildspec:
version: 0.2
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - echo "Starting parallel Docker build and ECR authentication..."
      - |
        docker build -t bedrock-agentcore-arm64 . &
        BUILD_PID=$!
        aws ecr get-login-password --region $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION | \
        docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 438327931823.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/bedrock-agentcore-genai_petstore_bella_grooming_agent &
        AUTH_PID=$!
        echo "Waiting for Docker build to complete..."
        wait $BUILD_PID
        if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
          echo "Docker build failed"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Waiting for ECR authentication to complete..."
        wait $AUTH_PID
        if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
          echo "ECR authentication failed"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Both build and auth completed successfully"
      - echo "Tagging image with version 20260909-134055-330..."
      - "docker tag bedrock-agentcore-arm64:latest 438327931823.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/bedrock-agentcore-genai_petstore_bella_grooming_agent:20260909-134055-330"
  post_build:
    commands:
      - echo "Pushing versioned image to ECR..."
      - "docker push 438327931823.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/bedrock-agentcore-genai_petstore_bella_grooming_agent:20260909-134055-330"
      - echo "Build completed at $(date)"
